key_insight: LLMs lose diagnostic accuracy when they must gather clinical information interactively rather than receive a complete case upfront.
clinical_relevance: Evaluating how models ask questions—not just interpret supplied findings—is important for assessing their readiness for clinical workflows.
method: Introduced Hx2Dx ARENA with 1,000 simulated encounters based on NEJM clinical cases.
Modeled history taking, physical examination, and diagnostic workup.
Evaluated open- and closed-source LLMs across configurations and compared interactive with static performance.
evidence_signal: Every evaluated model performed worse interactively than with the full case provided upfront; more targeted questioning was associated with better diagnosis.
watch_item: Performance in simulated cases does not establish real-world clinical safety, particularly when models must decide what information to seek.
paper_title: Hx2Dx: From Anamnesis to Diagnosis - A Multimodal Arena for Conversational Clinical Reasoning in LLMs
